description: Repairs r-cat-1b/qd-view-*: the reopen for the Updatable read was read-only (OpenDatabase(path, 0, -1)), so reopened QueryDef.Updatable (0) could not be compared with the writable creation handle (-1). On a writable copy of r-cat-1b-base, nine QueryDefs are created (select with an expression column, update, delete, append, make-table, crosstab, UNION ALL, DDL, parameterized select); for each the held QueryDef's Name, Type, ReturnsRecords and Updatable are read. The Database is closed and reopened WRITABLE and the same four members are read on QueryDefs.Item of each name. (The pass-through shape is left out: it needs an ODBC connect string.)
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT ID, A, B * 2 AS Twice FROM T WHERE B > 5 ORDER BY ID;
UPDATE T SET B = B + 1 WHERE ID > 0;
INSERT INTO W (ID, A) SELECT ID + 100, A FROM T;
SELECT ID, A INTO TNew FROM T;
TRANSFORM Sum(B) AS SB SELECT A FROM T GROUP BY A PIVOT ID;
SELECT ID, A FROM T UNION ALL SELECT ID, A FROM W;
PARAMETERS pId Long, pName Text ( 20 ); SELECT ID, A FROM T WHERE ID = pId OR A = pName;
